description.value: You automatically succeed at saving throws against any effect that would make you doubt yourself. Once per day, when you fail any check or saving throw, you may declare it a success instead, outright, with no roll and no reroll. You were never given the chance to be wrong. Now you simply aren't.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Automatic success vs any effect that would make you doubt yourself; once per day, declare a failed check/save a success outright, no roll, no reroll" is P-DEGREE-REACTIVE for the once-per-day clause (after-the-fact manufacture of a success, the confirmed-absent shape throughout this pass), and the "doubt yourself" trait/predicate this card's other clause would need doesn't exist in pf2e-source either.
